label: Study identifier
notes: Raw column 'Study ID'. Raw file has 3 IDs entered twice (exact duplicate rows); removed in cleaning.

label: Recruiting ICU
units_codes: ICU A / ICU B / ICU C / ICU D
notes: Raw 'Site' typed several ways (icu a, ICU-A, ICUA); standardised. ICU C reported lactate in mg/dL.

label: Date of ICU admission (enrolment)
notes: Raw 'Admission Date' mixes YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY and DD-Mon-YYYY.

label: Age
notes: Raw 'Age'. One impossible value (210) set to missing; query to site.

label: Sex
notes: Raw 'Sex' has 8-9 spellings (M, m, male, F, f, female, ' Female').

label: Body weight on admission
notes: Raw 'Weight (kg)'. One impossible value (7) set to missing. Used to compute balance in ml/kg.

label: Diabetes mellitus
notes: Raw codes Yes/No/Y/N/yes/no/1/0 (ICU B sends 1/0).

label: Chronic kidney disease
notes: Pre-specified confounder. Mixed Yes/No coding in raw file.

label: Chronic heart failure
notes: Pre-specified effect modifier (Q1). Mixed coding in raw file.

label: Hypertension
notes: Mixed coding in raw file.

label: Source of infection
units_codes: Respiratory / Urinary / Abdominal / Skin/soft tissue / Other
notes: Ordered as listed for tables.

label: SOFA score on ICU admission
notes: Severity; pre-specified confounder. Median 7 (IQR 5-9).

label: APACHE II score (first 24 h)
notes: Raw 'APACHE II'; 6 values coded -99 = not recorded.

label: Blood lactate on admission
notes: ~15% missing, more often in less severe patients (MAR). ICU C values in raw file are mg/dL (x 9.01): divided by 9.01 in cleaning.

label: Mean arterial pressure on admission
notes: Raw 'MAP (mmHg)'; 4 values coded 999.

label: Vasopressor on admission
notes: Pre-specified confounder. Mixed coding in raw file.

label: Invasive mechanical ventilation on admission
notes: Raw 'Mech vent'. Pre-specified confounder.

label: Total fluid input, ICU day 1
notes: All intravenous and enteral fluid incl. drugs and nutrition. Raw 'Fluid in D1 (ml)'.

label: Total fluid output, ICU day 1
notes: Urine, drains, ultrafiltration; insensible losses not included.

label: Total fluid output, ICU day 2
notes: One negative value (impossible) in raw file set to missing.

label: Cumulative fluid balance, ICU days 1-3
notes: = (sum of fluid in d1-3 - sum of fluid out d1-3) / weight_kg. Not in the raw file. Missing for 2 patients (weight or output missing). Main exposure (Q2, Q3: per 10 ml/kg).

label: Positive cumulative fluid balance at day 3
notes: Yes if cum_fluid_balance_d3_ml_kg > 0. Main exposure for Q1 and Q5.

label: Acute kidney injury, maximum KDIGO stage, ICU days 1-7
notes: Raw 'AKI stage (KDIGO)'.

label: Any acute kidney injury (KDIGO stage >= 1)
notes: Yes if aki_stage >= 1. Outcome for Q2.

label: Renal replacement therapy by day 28
notes: Mixed coding in raw file.

label: Ventilator-free days to day 28
notes: Days alive and free of invasive ventilation to day 28; 0 if died; 28 if never ventilated and alive. Raw 'VFD 28'. Outcome for Q3.

label: ICU length of stay
notes: Right-skewed. For patients who died, stay ends at death. Outcome for Q5 (survivors).

label: Death from any cause by day 28
notes: Primary outcome (Q1, Q4). Mixed coding in raw file.

label: Time from ICU admission to death or censoring
notes: Death day if died; 28 (censored) if alive at day 28. Use with died_28d for Kaplan-Meier and Cox. Raw 'Time to event 28d (days)'.
